title: bidens pilosa f. calcicola
intro: Bidens pilosa f. calcicola, commonly known as the Bidens calcicola or calcicole biden, is a plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae). Bidens pilosa f. calcicola is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits in reducing inflammation and improving immune function. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which make it effective in wound healing and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents of Bidens pilosa f. calcicola include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
